relationships.description: Ocelot routes /netcore/{everything} to netcoreapi downstream at systemdesign-api.azurewebsites.net:443/api/{everything} after authentication and authorization
Gateway loads NetAuth.Lib.dll (embedded binary) for identity resolution and permission enforcement on every authenticated request
netcoreapi uses NetAuth.Lib for user identity loading, field-level permission checks, and UI permission resolution
netcoreapi references Messaging.Contract to construct and publish typed CreateNotificationMessage and MessageEnvelope<T> instances
netnotificationapi references Messaging.Contract to deserialize consumed CreateNotificationMessage events from MassTransit
networker uses Messaging.Contract MessageEnvelope<T> for typed Kafka message deserialization
netcoreapi publishes CreateNotificationMessage via MassTransit (PostgreSQL transport); netnotificationapi is the MassTransit consumer
netcoreapi produces domain events to Confluent Kafka topic_0; networker subscribes as consumer group_0 for background processing
networker calls netnotificationapi REST endpoint (SendEmailNotification) directly via HTTP for triggered email notifications from Kafka-processed events
